Only methods declared in sugar-spring/src, or inherited from a parent declared there, are listed. A type that extends a class outside that tree, such as \RuntimeException, does not show the methods of that class.

SugarCraft\Spring

Lang final class

Per-library translation facade for sugar-spring.

Point final class

3D point. Same shape as Vector; kept as a distinct type for the same reason harmonica does — semantically a position vs. a delta.

MethodSummary
__construct(public readonly float $x, public readonly float $y, public readonly float $z = 0.0)
static zero(): self
static new(float $x, float $y, float $z = 0.0): selfFactory alias of the constructor — the house ::new() entry shape (finding 052); the same door as new Point(...).
add(Vector $v): selfAdd a Vector delta to this point, returning a new Point.
delta(self $to): VectorThe motion primitive: the Vector from this point to $to ($to − $this — the displacement a spring or projectile must traverse to get HERE there). Feeds Vector-returning callers (normalize for a direction, length for a budget) without hand-writing the subtraction. Coordinates near 1e308 overflow the difference to INF, which the Vector door refuses outright — distance() returns INF for that pair instead (it never builds a Vector); the asymmetry is by construction, not drift.
distance(self $other): floatEuclidean distance to another point. Returns INF when the squared deltas sum past PHP_FLOAT_MAX (extreme coordinates ~1e154 and up).
__toString(): string
static fromArray(array $wire): selfRebuild from the wire format jsonSerialize() emits: a positional [x, y, z] list (Point carries z like Vector — the serializer always emits three entries). **The index order is contractual and frozen**: this method and the serializer are two halves of one wire format. int entries (json_decode of 1 yields an int) are widened here; wrong arity or type is refused before the constructor sees a partial tuple, and finiteness stays the constructor's own door.
jsonSerialize(): arrayWire format: positional [x, y, z]. The index order is contractual — fromArray() decodes this exact shape and a re-ordered or keyed payload is a breaking change, not a style edit.

Projectile final class

Newtonian-physics projectile. Mirrors charmbracelet/harmonica.NewProjectile.

MethodSummary
__construct(public readonly float $deltaTime, public readonly Point $position, public readonly Vector $velocity, public readonly Vector $acceleration)
static new(float $deltaTime, Point $position, Vector $velocity, Vector $acceleration): self
update(): selfAdvance the simulation by one step. Returns a new Projectile — the original is untouched. Position += velocity·dt; velocity += acceleration·dt.
withPosition(Point $position): selfNew projectile at $position, same velocity/acceleration/frame time.
withVelocity(Vector $velocity): selfNew projectile with $velocity, same position/acceleration/frame time.
withAcceleration(Vector $acceleration): selfNew projectile with $acceleration, same position/velocity/frame time.
withDeltaTime(float $deltaTime): selfNew projectile stepping at $deltaTime, same state. 0.0 is a LEGAL value here (the accepted-freeze idiom, finding 049) and must not be swallowed by a naive null-coalescing rebuild — pinned.
position(): Point
velocity(): Vector
acceleration(): Vector
static gravity(): VectorGravity vector — Y-up, matching upstream harmonica Gravity = Vector{0, -9.81, 0}. Use this when porting examples from the harmonica docs verbatim. Returns a shared immutable instance (see the memo above).
static terminalGravity(): VectorTerminal-velocity gravity — Y-up, matching upstream harmonica TerminalGravity = Vector{0, -53, 0}. Shared immutable instance.
static gravityYDown(): VectorLegacy Y-down gravity. Earlier versions of SugarSpring used (0, +9.81, 0) (Y-down) — kept here so existing PHP code that relied on the old convention can opt back in via a single name change without flipping every Y-coord in the model. Shared immutable instance.
static terminalGravityYDown(): VectorLegacy Y-down terminal-velocity gravity. See gravityYDown(). Shared immutable instance.

Spring final class

Damped harmonic oscillator (Ryan Juckett's "Damped Springs"), with under-/critically-/over-damped branches chosen by the damping ratio — readable back off any live spring via self::dampingRatio().

MethodSummary
__construct(float $deltaTime, float $angularFrequency, float $dampingRatio, ?bool $reducedMotionOverride = null)
static new(float $deltaTime, float $angularFrequency, float $dampingRatio, ?bool $reducedMotionOverride = null): selfFactory alias of the constructor — the house ::new() entry shape, one vocabulary across the library (finding 052). Spring::new(...) and new Spring(...) are the same door, not two behaviours.
update(float $pos, float $vel, float $target): arrayAdvance one step toward $target, returning the new position and velocity.
deltaTime(): floatTuning triple: seconds elapsed per integration step.
angularFrequency(): floatTuning triple: rad/sec (NOT Hz) — see the constructor note.
dampingRatio(): floatTuning triple: <1 oscillating, =1 critical, >1 over-damped.
reducedMotionOverride(): ?boolThe pinned reduced-motion override, or null when it defers to the environment.
static resetReducedMotionProbe(): voidTest seam: forget the memoized reduced-motion verdict so the next probe re-reads the environment. Production callers should never need this — the point of the memo is that a process's a11y setting is read once. Environments that DO hot-swap REDUCE_MOTION mid-run (long-lived daemons re-reading config) are the documented reason this seam is public.
static settled(float $pos, float $vel, float $target, float $threshold = self::SETTLING_THRESHOLD): boolWhether a spring resting at ($pos, $vel) has settled at $target.
static fps(float $n): floatFrame-time (seconds) for a given frame rate. Spring::fps(60) → 1/60.
static fromPreset(SpringPreset $preset, ?float $deltaTime = null, ?bool $reducedMotionOverride = null): SpringConstruct a spring from a named preset at 60 fps.

SpringChain final class

Sequences multiple springs so that one spring's settle triggers the next.

SpringCollection final class

Manages multiple named spring instances.

Not listed: the methods of SugarCraft\Core\Concerns\Mutable, a trait declared outside src/.

MethodSummary
__construct(array $springs = [], array $positions = [], array $velocities = [], array $targets = [])
withSpring(string $id, Spring $spring, float $position = 0.0, float $velocity = 0.0, float $target = 0.0): selfReturn a NEW collection with the given spring added (immutable).
without(string $id): selfReturn a NEW collection with the named spring removed (immutable).
withTarget(string $id, float $target): selfReturn a NEW collection with the target for one spring changed (immutable).
tick(): selfAdvance every UNSETTLED spring by one step; settled members keep their floats untouched (finding 006 — cost follows motion, not collection size). Returns a NEW SpringCollection when anything advanced, leaving the original instance unchanged; a fully-settled collection returns $this identity.
position(string $id): floatThe current position of a spring by id — the house bare accessor.
velocity(string $id): floatGet the current velocity of a spring by id.
allVelocities(): arrayGet all current velocities, keyed by spring id.
settled(float $threshold = Spring::SETTLING_THRESHOLD): boolWhether EVERY spring in the collection has settled at its target.
has(string $id): boolCheck if a spring exists in the collection.
all(): arrayGet all current positions.
target(string $id): floatGet the target for a specific spring.

Vector final class

3D vector for Projectile. Immutable.

MethodSummary
__construct(public readonly float $x, public readonly float $y, public readonly float $z = 0.0)
static zero(): self
static new(float $x, float $y, float $z = 0.0): selfFactory alias of the constructor — the house ::new() entry shape (finding 052); the same door as new Vector(...).
add(self $other): self
sub(self $other): self
scale(float $s): selfScale all three components by $s.
length(): floatEuclidean length in 3D. Returns INF when the squared components sum past PHP_FLOAT_MAX (finite components ~1e154 and up).
dot(self $other): floatDot product.
cross(self $other): selfCross product. Returns a new perpendicular Vector.
lengthSquared(): floatSquared Euclidean length — avoids sqrt() for comparisons. Returns INF on overflow exactly like length() (components ~1e154 and up).
normalize(): selfNormalized (unit) vector.
lerp(self $other, float $t): selfLinear interpolation between this vector and $other.
__toString(): string
static fromArray(array $wire): selfRebuild from the wire format jsonSerialize() emits: a positional [x, y, z] list. **The index order is contractual and frozen** — this method and the serializer are two halves of one wire format, so no component may ever move or gain a name. int entries (json_decode of 1 yields an int) are widened here; everything else about the members — type, arity — is refused before the constructor ever sees a partial tuple, and finiteness stays the constructor's own door (one guard, no duplicated policy).
jsonSerialize(): arrayWire format: positional [x, y, z]. The index order is contractual — fromArray() decodes this exact shape and a re-ordered or keyed payload is a breaking change to every serialized vector, not a style edit.

CubicBezier final class

Cubic Bezier easing functions — matches the CSS cubic-bezier() spec.

MethodSummary
__construct(float $x1, float $y1, float $x2, float $y2)
static new(float $x1, float $y1, float $x2, float $y2): selfFactory alias of the constructor — the house ::new() entry shape (finding 052), SHIPPED rather than exempted on purpose: this class already serves static calls with named presets, and the uniform door costs nothing next to teaching five classes one vocabulary. Custom (off-table) curves take this door; the 26 named ones take their presets, which stay the memoized shared instances.
static cssEase(): selfThe CSS ease transition-timing-function keyword. Named cssEase() because the seam sampler ease() owns the bare spelling — PHP forbids one name as both static preset and instance sampler. The legacy static CubicBezier::ease() cannot forward through __callStatic() (the engine resolves it to the instance method and raises an Error) and fails loudly instead; migrate to cssEase().

static easeOut(): self

static __callStatic(string $name, array $arguments): selfBC door for the CSS-keyword preset, honestly stated: PHP resolves a static call to the instance sampler ease() and raises an Error WITHOUT consulting __callStatic, so no deprecation forwarder can exist for CubicBezier::ease(). The legacy spelling fails LOUDLY until 2.0.0; cssEase() is the preset. This hook guards the other static misses only: a typo must fail with a named refusal here, not quietly become some preset.
